items.q: The IUPAC name of CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃ is:
items.explain: The longest chain has 4 C; number from the end nearer the branch: methyl on C2.
items.explainAf: Die langste ketting het 4 C; nommer vanaf die kant naaste aan die vertakking: metiel op C2.

items.q: The IUPAC name of CH₃CH₂CH₂COOCH₂CH₃ is:
items.explain: The acid part (with C=O) has 4 C — butanoate; the alcohol part has 2 C — ethyl.
items.explainAf: Die suurdeel (met C=O) het 4 C — butanoaat; die alkoholdeel het 2 C — etiel.

items.q: The IUPAC name of CH₃CHBrCH₂CHO is:
items.explain: The –CHO carbon is C1, so the Br is on C3: 3-bromobutanal.
items.explainAf: Die –CHO-koolstof is C1, dus is die Br op C3: 3-bromobutanal.

items.explain: Isomers share a molecular formula but differ in structure.
items.explainAf: Isomere deel ’n molekulêre formule maar verskil in struktuur.

items.explain: Same chain and functional group, but the –OH is in a different position.
items.explainAf: Dieselfde ketting en funksionele groep, maar die –OH is in ’n ander posisie.

items.q: Which compound is a functional isomer of ethyl methanoate, HCOOCH₂CH₃?
items.qAf: Watter verbinding is ’n funksionele isomeer van etielmetanoaat, HCOOCH₂CH₃?
items.explain: Both are C₃H₆O₂; esters and carboxylic acids are functional isomers.
items.explainAf: Albei is C₃H₆O₂; esters en karboksielsure is funksionele isomere.

items.q: The IUPAC name of the ester formed from methanol and ethanoic acid.
items.qAf: Die IUPAC-naam van die ester wat uit metanol en etanoësuur gevorm word.

items.text: Isomers with the same functional group in different positions, such as butan-1-ol and butan-2-ol, are [[]] isomers. Isomers with different functional groups, such as propanal and propanone, are [[]] isomers.
items.textAf: Isomere met dieselfde funksionele groep in verskillende posisies, soos butan-1-ol en butan-2-ol, is [[]]isomere. Isomere met verskillende funksionele groepe, soos propanaal en propanoon, is [[]]isomere.

items.q: In IUPAC naming, the longest carbon chain containing the functional group is the parent chain.
items.qAf: In IUPAC-naamgewing is die langste koolstofketting wat die funksionele groep bevat, die stamketting.
items.explain: True. The chain is numbered to give the functional group the lowest number.
items.explainAf: Waar. Die ketting word genommer om die funksionele groep die laagste nommer te gee.

items.q: 2-methylbutane has four carbon atoms in total.
items.explain: False. Butane has 4 carbons plus one methyl group = 5 carbon atoms (C₅H₁₂).
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Butaan het 4 koolstowwe plus een metielgroep = 5 koolstofatome (C₅H₁₂).

items.q: Match each condensed formula in column A with its IUPAC name in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke gekondenseerde formule in kolom A by sy IUPAC-naam in kolom B.
